sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen2.5-Math: A series of math-specific large language ...
sources.snippet: The Qwen2.5-Math series models have achieved significant performance improvements compared to the Qwen2-Math series models on the Chinese and English mathematics benchmarks with CoT. Detailed performance and introduction are shown in this 📑 blog. 🚨 Qwen2.5-Math mainly supports solving English and Chinese math problems through CoT and TIR.
